environment: Node 22 native WebSocket/WebCrypto and worker_threads browser-worker adapter; loopback independent MQTT fixture, not a public broker or physical multi-device test
checks: MQTT 3.1.1 native WebSocket CONNECT / SUBSCRIBE / QoS1
Bounded parser accepts fragmentation and rejects oversized length
ECDH pairwise keys roundtrip, reject wrong AAD and replay
Browser host starts shared RoomService through MQTT
Guest joins encrypted invitation without local game server
Invitations pin broker and host key; malformed invitations rejected
Room ready / start sends distinct fog-filtered state to both peers
Encrypted game commands reach authority with sequence acknowledgement
Relay payload does not contain plaintext commands, player names or snapshots
Late observer enters read-only delayed spectator mode
Tampered ciphertext is rejected without applying game state
Client reconnect reuses seat and synchronizes a fresh baseline
Large encrypted payload fragments and reassembles completely
Public directory only appears after explicit public-room creation
Eight encrypted clients start and receive separately filtered player snapshots
Host relay outage pauses simulation and resumes its original session
Observer receives a snapshot no newer than 30 simulated seconds
Explicit host exit notifies remaining guests and cancels reconnect loops
